accessibility.description: House Access adds spoken menus, dialogue, and inventory, plus room scanning, target navigation, and spatial audio beacons. It requires the 64-bit Windows game and BepInEx 6 IL2CPP, with screen reader output or Windows SAPI speech. Fighting minigames, the in-game smartphone, and the developer console are not readable; some relationship, opportunity, and clothing details are unavailable. Follow the installation guide's BepInEx logging configuration step to avoid a startup crash.
